'''Varro''' was a male [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Major/Legends|major]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]], he was stationed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] inside the settlement of [[Olaris]].
